description:
Consort Yeongbi died of illness after five years of not being visited by Crown Prince Baekyoung, the cruel Crown Prince who beheaded his brothers. Goddess Yeohee entered the palace to eat Consort Yeongbi's spirit, but she was trapped inside the palace and had to enter Consort Yeongbi's body. After the incident, Crown Prince Baekyoung became interested in the consort. The aim of Consort Yeongbi, eh, Goddess Yeohee is actually getting out of the palace!  With bulging eyes, Baekyoung looked at Yeohee.   
"Are you human or ghost?"   
Yeohee laughed as if hearing a joke.    
"Not both."   
"Then what are you?"
